about: Pockets by eye (Claude), camera view, with P-IDs from the approved rule: the rack is at the camera-left end in both racks, so the foot end is camera-left, same as rack 1 (P1 far-left, P2 near-left, P3 near side, P4 near-right, P5 far-right, P6 far side). conf = how sure the by-eye pocket is.
